note: Diagnostic audit of every mapped single-path trace, including layouts with existing borders and models. Composed networks delegate to their independently audited component layouts; uncomposed networks remain unverified. Runtime crossing levels measure the saved reconstruction, not the physical bridge or vehicle clearance. A three-metre difference is only a diagnostic threshold. Missing source profiles, unexplained intersections and runtime errors remain unresolved; model availability does not establish accurate bridge elevations. No source geometry, borders, timing or models are changed.
